reproductionScope: Wire, signatures, logs and raw projections reproduce exactly; full-store account names reproduce modulo one unchanged/unreferenced internal LiteSVM airdrop funding key. normalize() checks original full frames first and refuses changes/reference to that funding account.
resolvedDownstreamLockScope: Own lock governs graph; upstream workspace Cargo.lock does not govern downstream selection. No full compiler-lib/compiled-cache/registry-source closure pin.
accountFrameScope: Trusted Rust enumerates entire LiteSVM store; independent Python checks metadata/data hashes, raw custody/token/mint/Clock throughout and program/ProgramData raw bytes in initial record. Frozen artifact hashes and unchanged frames bind later execution. PDA canonicality/off-curve selection trusted; supplied-bump hash checked. Clock account/syscall-cache fidelity and manually inspected ABI/source mapping trusted.
signatureScope: Finite signed executor cases and exact executor-signature corruption rejected before execution; cryptography/runtime fidelity trusted. No universal authority proof.
rollbackScope: Finite three-instruction transaction abort (budget, transfer, unsupported request) after successful custody transfer/token CPI; fee effect and nonce reuse. No same-custody-instruction failure or validator/deployment proof.
normalizedSerialization: UTF8 json.dumps(full normalize(record_list), sort_keys=True, separators=(comma,colon)), no trailing newline; ensure_ascii default True
